newest_result.statement: The corrected dense and intrinsic-boundary searches contain 30 exact total-intersection-two P1/P2 pairs in 71,302,414 section tests. Exhausting 9,456,854 subsequent P3 candidates found no complete Gram triple. A sampled pair-first extension at p=17,19,23 performed 88,931,043 further section tests and exhaustively checked 5,315,813 P3 candidates after its three eligible pairs, again with zero P3. The full incidence reduces to a 61-by-62 Jacobian and six P3 remainder equations. Independently, the target essential lattice is proved to have the same cyclic discriminant form and X(6,79) Clifford fingerprint as the determinant-948 Shimura landscape.
